CustomField.description: Timestamp the Account most recently entered its CURRENT Onboarding_Status__c value. Set by AccountTriggerHandler.beforeInsert (initial status) and beforeUpdate (whenever Onboarding_Status__c changes) — never set anywhere else. Distinct from CreatedDate (total time in the pipeline since the record existed at all): this is "how long has it been stuck in the stage it's in right now," which CreatedDate cannot answer once a supplier has moved through more than one stage. Drives the "days in this stage" / stalled-case indicator in the Procurement (P2) and Analyst (A1) queues.
CustomField.label: Stage Entered DateTime
